text: The Chair, Board of Directors of TO Live has submitted the following item for the agenda of the TO Live Board Special Meeting of July 10, 2020: Facilitators for the Board of Directors of TO Live.

The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Deferred consideration of the Item to a Special Meeting of the Board to be held following consultation with the City Manager on, among other topics, options for a scope of work and timing of engagement for Board facilitators.
